remarks:
Welcome to your own private retreat! Set on 5 acres with a mix of open space and partially wooded areas, this charming ranch-style home offers the perfect blend of comfort, character, and country living.

Inside, an open-concept layout connects the living room, dining area, and kitchen, creating a spacious setting for everyday living and entertaining. The home features 3 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, providing plenty of space for family and guests.

The spacious primary suite features cathedral ceilings, knotty pine walls, mahogany wood floors, a full private bathroom, and a walk-in closet. The second bedroom also features cathedral ceilings, knotty pine walls, and mahogany flooring. Large picture windows throughout the bedrooms bring in lots of natural light 

Step outside onto the covered front porch with its impressive cathedral ceiling—the perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind while taking in the tranquility of the property.

An attached oversized 2-car garage provides ample room for vehicles, equipment, and storage, complete with an additional lean-to. The property also includes a storage shed with lean-tos, plus a unique bunkhouse shed with pop-out bed platforms and electric—ideal for guests. 

Located close to snowmobile trails, Bemus Point, and Chautauqua Lake, this property offers convenient access to year-round recreation and everything the area has to offer. Whether you're looking for a year-round home or a weekend getaway, this property is ready to welcome you.
